name: Content

semantics.id: canonical content identifier within a domain
semantics.type: how the resolved content resource is presented
semantics.provider: resolver namespace describing where or through which resolver the resource is obtained
semantics.content: inline payload or provider-relative resource identifier

validation: a Content record contains only id, domain, type, provider and content
id, domain and provider use [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]* identifiers
type is one of the canonical Content types
validation does not infer navigation, action, layout or domain semantics

providerModel.registry: providers are explicitly registered by provider id
providerModel.resolution: provider receives a frozen canonical Content record and optional caller context
providerModel.authority: provider resolves source location/value only; it does not redefine Content type semantics
providerModel.duplicateProvider: registration fails instead of silently replacing an existing resolver

providerRules: provider is not limited to external services
provider may resolve to an asset namespace or directory
embed providers such as youtube are handled by provider-specific resolvers
asset/embed provider resource identifiers are relative to their provider namespace
absolute filesystem paths, absolute resource URLs in canonical content identifiers, backslash paths and parent/current-directory traversal are forbidden
embed providers return structured descriptors and never authoritative HTML or iframe payloads
resolved asset/embed URLs exposed by WebEngine must be root-relative or use http(s); javascript:, data:, file:, blob: and protocol-relative URLs are rejected

embed.shape: id, domain, type=embed, provider, resource, url, optional title
embed.rule: embed resolution remains structured data; arbitrary HTML is not accepted as authority

rules: canonical Content identity and relations are DWH authority
WebEngine consumes projected Content records and does not become persistence or relation authority
Content does not own navigation hierarchy or action execution
type describes presentation semantics; provider describes runtime source resolution
resolved Content descriptors are runtime presentation inputs and never source authority
provider failure does not cause WebEngine to invent canonical fallback content

dwhProjection.rule: canonical declaration is loaded from DWH before provider/runtime resolution; WebEngine has no file fallback
